mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% for three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a labor market contraction that reduces labor demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 6-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
